description: Ministry of Defence - Order under the Firing Range and Military Training Act, to establish 'the Small Arms Firing Range of the Sri Lanka Air Force Academy, China Bay'
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the establishment and regulation of a military firing range under the Firing Ranges and Military Training Act. It contains legal orders and regulations made by the President under statutory authority, including the establishment of the range, determination of its use, and regulatory provisions governing its operation. While it mentions the President by name, this is in the context of exercising legal powers rather than personnel appointment or portfolio assignment. The content focuses on legal/regulatory framework creation rather than government structure, personnel changes, or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
